skill.name: clarity-gate
skill.description: Pre-ingestion verification guidance for improving epistemic quality in RAG systems using a 9-point review and two-round human review workflow.
skill.summary: Guides teams through source verification before adding documents to RAG knowledge bases.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static URL findings are false positives because they are repository references in SKILL.md, not executable network calls. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or other semantic abuse evidence was found in the reviewed file.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is a source metadata field pointing to the upstream repository. It is not executed, fetched, or used to transmit data.
The URL appears only as a documentation link to the source repository. No code or instruction directs the agent to make a network request.

content.value_statement: RAG projects can ingest weak or unsupported sources that reduce answer quality. This skill gives a structured verification workflow before content enters the knowledge base.
actual_capabilities: Defines when to run pre-ingestion source verification for RAG content.
Frames a 9-point quality review for documents and sources.
Supports a two-round human-in-the-loop review process.
Helps reviewers decide whether content should enter a knowledge base.
Provides guidance patterns, not executable automation.
limitations: Does not provide code, scripts, or automated validators.
Does not fetch, crawl, or inspect external repositories by itself.
Requires users to supply the documents and review criteria.
Cannot prove factual accuracy without supporting evidence.

use_cases.title: Review Knowledge Base Sources
use_cases.description: Data teams can screen articles, manuals, and research notes before indexing them for RAG.

use_cases.title: Standardize Editorial Review
use_cases.description: Documentation teams can apply consistent quality checks before approving content for retrieval.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Evidence
use_cases.description: Governance reviewers can document why a source was accepted, rejected, or sent for human review.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Source
prompt_templates.prompt: Use clarity-gate to assess this source before RAG ingestion. Identify quality concerns and whether human review is needed.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Candidate Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Use clarity-gate to compare these candidate sources for a RAG knowledge base. Rank them by reliability and ingestion readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Review Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use clarity-gate to create a two-round human review workflow for our RAG corpus. Include reviewer roles and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Ingestion Decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Use clarity-gate to audit this proposed ingestion decision. Test the evidence, identify unsupported assumptions, and recommend accept, reject, or hold.

output_examples.input: A team submits a vendor blog post for inclusion in a support RAG index.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a source quality review, evidence gaps, and a recommendation to hold pending a stronger primary source.

output_examples.input: A documentation manager wants consistent checks for product manuals before indexing.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a repeatable review checklist, human review steps, and clear accept or reject guidance.

output_examples.input: A compliance reviewer needs to explain why a policy source was rejected.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes the weak evidence, the affected quality checks, and a reviewer-ready rationale.

best_practices: Use primary sources when available and record why each source was accepted.
Run both human review rounds before adding high-impact content to a RAG index.
Keep evidence notes linked to each ingestion decision.
anti_patterns: Do not ingest sources only because they are easy to crawl.
Do not skip human review for legal, medical, financial, or policy content.
Do not treat the workflow as proof that a source is correct.

faq.question: Does this skill run an automated scanner?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and patterns for human-assisted source verification.

faq.question: Can it verify live web pages by itself?
faq.answer: No. Users must provide the source material or ask the agent to use available browsing tools.

faq.question: What does the 9-point verification cover?
faq.answer: It helps reviewers examine source quality, evidence support, and readiness for RAG ingestion.

faq.question: Who should use the two-round HITL workflow?
faq.answer: Teams that need a second reviewer before important content enters a knowledge base.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is documented as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains only SKILL.md instructions and no scripts.
